title: SessionModeSet
description: Result of session.set_mode (daemons with session_controls): what the session runs in now. ok=false: the change failed (error says why); Codex and Antigravity apply nothing then, Claude may have applied the parts before the failing one (mode, then model, then effort). The fields are always what the session runs in after it.

permission_mode.description: Claude: the SDK mode; Codex and Antigravity: the set_mode value they map from.

applies.description: now: in force already; next_turn: from the session's next turn; next_open: the session is not running, it opens with it.
